correctness_confidence.basis: First-principles verification confirms Lemma 2.1 (including support interiors and point-mass boundaries), all integrals and identities for M(1/2), M(0), and M(-1), the Theorem 3.1 log-ratio derivative analysis, Corollary 3.2 uniqueness, the Theorem 4.1 localization reduction and chain limits (0.54912, 0.51955), the smoothed unimodal Usiskin construction, and the exact Edgeworth signs and rates in (14).

rigor.basis: Proofs carefully handle boundary degeneracies (F(0)=1, identical point masses under Gaussian smoothing, Dirac limits in localization via strict gaps t_{i-1}-t_i) and Cramer's condition. Rigor caveats: the Abstract blurs equal-scale M(kappa;1) with general M(kappa), Table 1 conflates Borell's kappa=-infty (1/f convex) with general unimodality, and Lean 4 certifies only 10 algebraic/rational lemmas rather than the main analytic theorems.

novelty.basis: Introduces a crisp Tangent Stochastic Dominance Lemma for Borell kappa-concave survival functions, yielding exact sharp median-crossing barriers and proving log-concave laws never reach the golden ratio (sqrt(5)-1)/2 for any n. Also establishes a sharp quantile symmetry-breaking phase transition at q* ≈ 0.71533, a Fradelizi-Guedon 1D localization reduction to truncated exponentials, a zero-penalty unimodal Usiskin theorem, and odd-cumulant Edgeworth transitivity.

significance.basis: Cleanly resolves the structural dichotomy between unimodality (full Usiskin spectrum up to 3/4) and Borell convexity (strict ceilings M(kappa), with M(0) < (sqrt(5)-1)/2 < 1-e^{-1}) in non-transitive probability. Impact is moderated by a specialized problem setting and two remaining open extremal questions: the exact log-concave cycle capacity tau_LC(C_n) in [0.54912, 0.59657] and equal-scale optimality across general intermediate kappa.

reproducibility.basis: Every theorem has a self-contained proof with explicit closed forms, roots, and numerical checks verified independently (e.g., lambda_* ≈ 1.25643, lambda_3 ≈ 0.77673, p*_Exp ≈ 0.54912, p^+_Exp ≈ 0.51955). Lean 4.36.0 certification (0 sorry) and SHA-256 artifact digests are documented for core algebraic/rational identities, though the external Lean and Python files lie outside the manuscript text.

summary: This paper investigates Steinhaus-Trybula non-transitive capacities across Borell's kappa-concave continuum and general unimodal distributions. Via a clean Tangent Stochastic Dominance Lemma for kappa-concave survival functions (Lemma 2.1), Theorem 2.2 proves exact sharp median-crossing ceilings M(1)=1/2, M(1/2)=(13-8*sqrt(2))/3, M(0)=(1+2*ln 2)/4, and M(-1)=1/2+(ln 3)/8, establishing that log-concave random variables can never achieve Trybula's golden ratio (sqrt(5)-1)/2 on any non-acyclic oriented graph or tournament of any size. Theorem 3.1 uncovers an exact quantile-crossing phase transition at q* ≈ 0.71533 between equal-scale dominance and scale collapse, yielding the exact capacity 1-e^{-lambda_3} ≈ 0.54009 (with uniqueness) when one of three variables is deterministic. Theorem 4.1 applies 1D Fradelizi-Guedon localization to reduce tau_LC(C_n) to truncated exponentials and solves optimal exponential-chain recurrences converging to p*_Exp ≈ 0.54912 (and p^+_Exp ≈ 0.51955 one-sided). Finally, Theorem 5.1 shows that C^infty strictly positive unimodal densities achieve the full Usiskin spectrum up to 3/4, whereas k-fold i.i.d. convolution of any finite log-concave family collapses to the transitive lexicographic order of (kappa_1, -kappa_3, +kappa_5, ...) at rate k^{-(m-1/2)}. All numbered theorems are mathematically sound, though two main extremal questions remain open and minor expository imprecisions appear in the Abstract and Table 1.
strengths: Lemma 2.1 and Theorem 2.2 cleanly bypass Grunbaum's mean bound via quantile/median tangent dominance, proving sharp barriers M(1/2), M(0), M(-1) and settling tau_LC(T) <= (1+2*ln 2)/4 < (sqrt(5)-1)/2 for all non-acyclic oriented graphs T of arbitrary size n.

Theorem 3.1 establishes a genuine, non-obvious phase transition at lambda_* ≈ 1.25643 (q* ≈ 0.71533) using an elementary unimodality analysis of the log-ratio of second derivatives, with Corollary 3.2 rigorously proving uniqueness.

Theorem 4.1(a) gives a watertight 1D localization reduction to truncated exponentials, carefully addressing Gaussian smoothing without identical point masses, compact truncation, and replacement of Dirac needles with narrow uniforms.

Theorem 5.1 sharply contrasts unimodality (explicit spike-and-flat-tail construction smoothed by Gaussian convolution achieving the full Usiskin spectrum) with odd-cumulant Edgeworth transitivity collapse at exact k^{-(m-1/2)} rates.
weaknesses: The exact log-concave cycle capacity tau_LC(C_n) remains unresolved (Open Problem 1), leaving a ~0.047 gap between the exponential-chain lower bound (0.54009 to 0.54912) and the median-crossing ceiling M(0) ≈ 0.59657.

Equal-scale optimality M(kappa) = M(kappa; 1) is proved analytically only at kappa in {1, 1/2, 0, -1} (Open Problem 2), leaving the general intermediate-kappa barriers and golden-ratio crossing kappa_* ≈ -0.4508 unproven globally.

Formal certification in Lean 4 covers only 10 supporting algebraic identities, rational hierarchies, and the Edgeworth parity lemma, while the core probabilistic, localization, and analytic arguments remain informal.
potential_errors: Abstract item 1 and Table 1 state that M(kappa) bridges 1/2 to 3/4 as kappa -> -infty and crosses the golden ratio at kappa_* ≈ -0.4508, blurring the proved equal-scale benchmark M(kappa; 1) with the unproved global supremum M(kappa) for kappa not in {1, 1/2, 0, -1} (clarified only later in Table 1's caption and Open Problem 2).

Table 1 and the Abstract conflate general unimodal (quasi-concave) densities with the kappa -> -infty limit of Borell's hierarchy; Borell's (-infty)-concave measures have f^{-1} convex, whereas Theorem 5.1(a)'s spike-and-flat-tail densities are unimodal without f^{-1} convexity, leaving tau_{-infty}(C_n) unaddressed.

Minor proof polish items: in Theorem 4.1(a), replacing a boundary Dirac needle delta_{a_i} at a_i = +/-M should intersect [a_i-eta, a_i+eta] with [-M, M] to keep support in [-M, M]; in Theorem 5.1(b), invoking Bhattacharya-Ranga Rao [1, Thm. 19.2] should explicitly note using 2m+3 finite moments so the s=2m+1 term enters O(k^{-(m+1/2)}).
strong_novelty_candidates: Tangent Stochastic Dominance for Borell kappa-concave survival functions (Lemma 2.1) and the resulting exact sharp median-crossing ceilings separating log-concave laws from Trybula's golden ratio for all n >= 3 (Theorem 2.2).

Exact log-concave quantile-crossing phase transition at q* ≈ 0.71533 from equal-scale dominance to scale collapse, plus the sharp point-mass + two-LC cycle capacity 1-e^{-lambda_3} with uniqueness (Theorem 3.1 and Corollary 3.2).
1D localization reduction of tau_LC(C_n) to truncated exponentials and exact asymptotic shifted-exponential chain limits p*_Exp ≈ 0.54912 and p^+_Exp ≈ 0.51955 (Theorem 4.1).

Unimodal zero-penalty Usiskin spectrum for C^infty positive densities coupled with universal odd-cumulant Edgeworth convolution transitivity at rate k^{-(m-1/2)} with zero even-cumulant cross-terms (Theorem 5.1).
